data.name: Oula
data.gender_notes: Oula is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'al-ula', which means 'the beginning' or 'the first'. In Islam, Oula symbolizes the enlightenment and guidance brought by the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) at the beginning of the Islamic era. The name Oula carries the meaning “Light, Illumination” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Oula usually hope their child will grow to embody light, illumination and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes guidance, enlightenment, and beginning of a new journey in Islam.
data.etymology: Oula belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Illumination.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Oula total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
